notes.title: What type of gamer are you?
notes.content:
We know that there are many different types of gamer. Some people need lots of action and adrenaline, some want to really rack their brains to solve a quest, some just want to enjoy themselves and indulge in the story.

Of course, there is no game that really satisfies everyone. That's not our aim either. It's clear that we cater for players who enjoy story, excitement and puzzles. Nevertheless, for The Ebbing we thought it would be nice to give our players a few options to customise their gaming experience.

[h2]Different game modes for all types[/h2]

In [b]story mode,[/b] the quest log gives you plenty of clues as to what you need to do next to solve the case. It is ideal for people who simply want to immerse themselves in the story and solve exciting puzzles.
[b]
Detective mode [/b]gives you fewer clues in the quest log and you are responsible for writing down your findings yourself and not losing track. Who have you already questioned? What information are you missing? This mode is for hardcore detectives.

If you have to sneak past enemies, you can also [b]adjust the stealth difficulty[/b]. This also allows you to set how exciting these parts of the game are. If you get scared easily (and don't like doing that), this setting is basically your [b]tension regulator[/b].

If our [b]dice skill checks[/b] are trying your patience a little too much, we now offer to [b]simplify them or even switch them off completely[/b] so that you can get even more involved in the story.

What type of gamer are you? Let us know!

notes.title: What's new in the game play of Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing?
notes.content:
Only a few more weeks until [i]Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing[/i] is released! We're looking forward to it - are you?

We've taken a lot from the feedback on our [i]Ebbing[/i] demos and of course [i]A Bavarian Tale[/i]. It's really amazing how much you get into a tunnel yourself and no longer perceive things neutrally. That's why your feedback, which reaches us either via Discord or here on Steam, is incredibly important to us! As a result, we've reworked some aspects of the gameplay, added new mechanics, but also let things go. And of course, some things have stayed the same.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357469/b72dff0cf042eea8fae391d7eef26a3ce5737252.jpg[/img]

[h3]At least 5 different endings[/h3]

In [i]The Ebbing[/i], your decisions also influence the outcome of the game. Depending on who you make friends with in Havstedt, you will gain information that will help you solve the case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357469/ba9360db5eb3e7594ad1785264ad989544c34f37.jpg[/img]

[h3]Even more detective work[/h3]

With the revised Detective Sweep, you can make sure that you haven't overlooked anything in a room. You can now also inspect elements and examine them for hidden clues, just as you can find important clues in furniture. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357469/165f16e977e97e7b9ac81e6c1e54ba0103d5e534.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improved stealth mechanics[/h3]

Our stealth mechanic in [i]A Bavarian Tale[/i] was ... definitely one of our wilder experiments as First Time Game Devs. That's why we completely reworked it over [i]The Ebbing[/i] and built some very nice quests around it that will hopefully keep you on the edge of your seat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357469/3cdbd634ff158ed34002125908a42ba7dafb02ad.jpg[/img]

[h3]New: Combination and number puzzles[/h3]

Some information is hidden behind tricky combination and number puzzles. In [i]The Ebbing[/i], it's no longer just your interpersonal skills that are required in dialogs with the NPCs, but also your deduction skills.

[h3]No longer included: Fistfights[/h3]

Yes, we know you loved the music during the fights in [i]A Bavarian Tale[/i]. However, the fistfights themselves were one of our most buggy mechanics and didn't really add much to the story. Since we know that there are quite a few RPG players who would like to play a game without combat mode, we're going to give it a try. Our Inspector Valentin really isn't a powerhouse - otherwise he wouldn't have become a civil servant.

What is your favorite gameplay element from The [i]Ebbing[/i] demo or the prologue? Play it and let us know on our Discord server!

notes.title: We're part of Next Fest with Inspector Schmidt – The Ebbing!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our demo has now been out for a week and has been played by several streamers! We’d like to say thank you – your support helps [i]Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing[/i] reach more people.

We joined several streams live in the chat and had a great time with the communities, especially when unexpected bugs led to some hilarious moments. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/search?term=inspector%20schmidt%3A%20the%20ebbing&type=videos]Here’s a list of all the Twitch streams that have played [i]The Ebbing[/i] so far.[/url]

In the meantime, we’ve fixed a lot of bugs that were reported to us via Steam, Discord, and the Twitch community. If you’ve been waiting for a smoother gameplay experience, [b]next week is a great time to check out the [i]Ebbing [/i]demo.[/b]


[h2]From February 24th to March 3rd, Steam Next Fest is happening – and we’re part of it![/h2]

[b][i]Why is this important?[/i][/b]

During Next Fest, Steam showcases demos of unreleased games to a large audience. The more people support us during this time by adding us to their wishlist or leaving reviews, the more likely Steam’s algorithm will notice us –[b]and boost our visibility even further.[/b]

So if you play our demo soon and enjoy it, we’d be thrilled if you [b]added it to your wishlist and left a review![/b]

[b]On February 27th, we’ll be streaming live on Steam[/b] as we play our demo. We’d love to have viewers join us! At the same time, we’re hosting a [url=https://discord.gg/GuR6WZra?event=1342477969272082624]watch party on Discord[/url] – you’re warmly invited to join, chat with us, and help solve the quest.

If you’re planning to stream the demo yourself in the next few weeks, [url=mailto:presse@activefungus-studios.de]let us know![/url] We’ll try to be present in as many stream chats as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357469/f50f1353898094aa530af0abb1151c4c5b4fea71.png[/img]

[h3]By the way: Have you already gotten your character booklet 'The residents of Havstedt?' [/h3]

It's a[b] free PDF introducing the NPCs from [i]Inspector Schmidt – The Ebbing[/i],[/b] giving you an overview of their quirks, motives and preferences. We also included space for personal notes, very handy if you play [i]The Ebbing [/i]in Detective Mode with reduced hints in the quest log. Quite a few people did this in past streams with [i]A Bavarian Tale![/i] 

[b][url=https://activefungus-studios.de/en/sign-up-the-ebbing-character-booklet/]Get the character booklet here![/url][/b]

Yours,
The Active Fungus Team

We are happy to share a big tech update for [b]Inspector Schmidt - A Bavarian Tale[/b] with you!

notes.title: Roadmap Update
notes.content:
We decided we will move the project to UE 5 and already made good progress with that. We hope to be able to provide Steamdeck support, controller support, better graphics and better performance. But moving from UE 4 to UE 5 will take some time. We hope to have the UE 5 version ready in about 3 weeks.

There are many things we want to improve on "A Bavarian Tale - Totgeschwiegen". The table below shows the planned Roadmap. This is a rough overview of what features and progresses we hope to make, but the contents are subject to change as we advance. We would love to hear your opinion on this. Please let us know what features and improvements you feel are the most important ones and if there is anything missing from this Roadmap.

Roadmap 22.02.23

March 2023
- Move to UE 5
- Improve character graphics
- Add controller support
- See if we can get the game to work on Steamdeck
- Improve performance
- Fix too small subtitle font
- Bring the demo up to date and have it available again (probably for a limited time only)
- Better sorting options for inventory (categorys)
- Fix bowling/kegeln bug
- Fix problem with special signs in savegames


Coming weeks
- Add Steamcloud Savegames
- Steam Collectors-Cards

Longterm
- Improve on all localizations
- Record and implement narrator for all Choose-Your-Own-Adventure parts

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
Dank eurem fleißigen Feedback haben wir viele Ideen gesammelt und wollen euch hier das erste größere Update präsentieren:
- neuer Kompass
- überarbeitete Gegner AI
- haufenweise neues 2D Artwork
- neue Choose Your Own Adventure Parts
- Neue Map (Umgebungskarte)
- "betrunken" Zustand
- neue NPCs
- neuer Cursor
- Schleichen als "toggle"
- Savegames mit Datum und Zeit

Der bisherige Austausch mit unserer noch kleinen Discord Community gibt uns den richtigen Antrieb und zeigt uns immer wieder, wo noch Entwicklungspotenzial ist. Daher hoffen wir nicht nur durch eine größere Discord Community, sondern auch durch unser In-Game Feedback Tool auf neue Impulse, Kritik und vielleicht auch Lob.
Als junges, kleines und agiles Team können wir Ideen aus der Community zügig umsetzen und testen. Was unseren Studio-internen Vorstellungen und Zielen entspricht reichen wir direkt an die Community zurück um auf kurzem Weg herauszufinden, was bei unseren Spieler:innen ankommt.
